notes: The program is Cuyamaca College's CSU General Education Breadth Certificate of Achievement, but the source URL and text are Grossmont College's general education page. The text prints only the Grossmont Plan A local GE requirements for the AA/AS (Areas 1-5) and no section for a CSU GE Breadth certificate, so no blocks were recorded. A reviewer should locate Cuyamaca's own CSU GE Breadth certificate page.
The text is cut off partway through Area 5 (at 'CHEM-110 Environmental Chemi'), so later areas and any certificate section may be missing.
The 'Recipients of an Associate Degree will be equipped to:' list belongs to the associate degree general education philosophy, not to this certificate, so it was not recorded as program outcomes.
No total units, careers, or outcomes for this award appear in the text.
